## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link any related issue or roadmap milestone.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results. Distinguish simulator checks, firmware builds, and physical bench tests. For documentation changes, note link and example checks.

## Visuals or measurements

Include before/after screenshots for interface changes or measured evidence for hardware claims. Omit this section when it does not apply.

## Remaining limitations

Note anything relevant that has not been verified. Omit this section when it does not apply.
